title: Immerse in the City full of culture, history and good food !
text: What a delightful tour! From the guide and owner Justo made every part of the experience fun, and added a bit of culture and history to the stories he shared, with us. The amazing tapas spots to the parks, landmarks and monuments we soaked up the culture of Madrid !
author: Glenn_M

title: TAPAS TOUR
text:
My friends and I decided to join the tapas tour: a bike tour with 3 stops in 3 bars to taste the local cuisine: tapas. Our guide was Natalia and with us there were 2 other American couples, it was amazing and fun to communicate with them too.
It was a fantastic and innovative experience that allowed us to combine the panoramic and cultural visit of the city with the local gastronomy. Despite the cold it was very warm to stop in the sun eating typical cuisine in the wonderful park of Maria Luisa.
When I return to Seville I would definitely stay there again, super recommended!!!
author: giorgial2023

title: The best way to see Sevilla with the  best guide!
text: I came in March to celebrate my birthday with a group of friends and family. Javi took us on a 4 hour tour of the city and it was by far the best part of our trip. He was so friendly, entertaining and knowledgeable about the city - it felt like we were being shown around by an old friend. He took us to a great place for lunch and gave some great recommendations for places to eat/drink that we wouldn't have found otherwise. Thank you Javi for making our trip so memorable!
author: Libbeh123

title: Very original and Comprehensive tour by Anotnio!
text: We were guided by Antonio, with his very original and entertaining interpretation of Seville's history. Exceptional value for money too - the 12 o'clock tour returned at 19:20pm!
author: SnP-UK

title: bike tour
text:
We enjoyed our bike tour on our first day in Seville 
A great way to see to learn about the city and find our way around 
Our guide , Antonio , was fun and gave us a personal history of Seville and lots of tips of where to visit and eat & drink during our stay 
We would recommend this tour
author: Marc J

title: Excellent Cycle Tour! 5 Stars!
text: Had a fantastic time on this bike tour! Our tour guide Javi was great...very knowledgeable and good fun!
author: Addy2015

title: Antonio Caballos, most passionate/best tour guide I've ever had!
text:
Antonio showed us the whole city. He took 3 extra hours to wind us through the city to his favorite spots, explaining all the history while covering all the burrows. We took time to stop in his favorite places and enjoy the view or have a coffee & soak up the atmosphere. 

Aside from the fabulous city I walked away with more than enough amazing restaurant recommendations/experience recommendations. I couldn't have been happier I started my trip with Antonio because it enabled me to have an incredible, local and intentional trip the rest of the time. I would 10/10 recommend this guy!

title: Brilliant and entertaining way to see the city
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our guided bike ride with Antonio today! Very funny but very knowledgeable about Seville too. A great way to find your bearings quickly. The staff at the office at the Mercado were lovely too
author: flynno

title: Fantastic bike tour!
text:
We saw a lot, learned a lot and laughed a lot. Antonio has been a fantastic guide - very knowledgeable and a real entertainer. We went away with a much better understanding of Sevilla and its culture plus loads of great tips about what else to do and where to eat. 
Highly recommended!
author: 63katjab

title: Thanks Antonio Caballos and SeeByBike
text: Antonio Caballos gave us an unforgettable day trip on the bike through Sevilla! He explained every highlight and literally told a million stories. We enjoyed it and recommend a day trip with Antonio. He also provided us with many tips for tapas, bars and highlights in the city!
